author: ETA PRIME
description:
In this video, we take a first look at the all-new Anbernic RG Vita (RGB Vita). With a design inspired by the legendary Sony PS Vita, is this the Android handheld emulator we've been waiting for? We dive into the specs, compare the ergonomics directly against the original PS Vita, and test emulation performance on the Unisoc T618 chip.

Buy it here:https://anbernic.com?sca_ref=2193181.CeT6UNbFuN

From PS1 and PSP to harder-to-run systems like GameCube and PS2, we see exactly what this handheld can handle. Plus, we discuss the controversial D-pad design and whether you should pick this up or wait for the rumored Pro version.
